_comment: Filled in by the frontend build once real scene anchors and interaction selectors existed in the DOM (site/src/components/Scenes.tsx, TillBar.tsx, SceneNav.tsx, Scenes.tsx's ShelfScene). Every anchorSelector/trigger below was verified against the built site/dist bundle.

interactionStates._comment: Phone-only: the Bridge Slip bottom sheet, tapped open to show all 7 lines. Scrolls to Year instantly (not via the nav's smooth scroll, which races the scroll-position IntersectionObserver on a long page) before clicking; .slip-month only renders under 768px, so this is a no-op at tablet/desktop.
Phone-only: the collapsed Till Bar's "Filters (n)" button opening the full-height sheet. .filters-button is display:none above 767px, so this is a no-op at tablet/desktop.

heavyInteraction.label: Season scroll-scrub (rapid, repeated)
heavyInteraction.trigger: const wrap = document.querySelector('.scene-pin-wrapper'); if (wrap) { let dir = 1; const start = window.scrollY + wrap.getBoundingClientRect().top; const id = setInterval(() => { window.scrollBy(0, dir * 40); const y = window.scrollY; if (y <= start) dir = 1; if (y >= start + wrap.offsetHeight - window.innerHeight) dir = -1; }, 16); window.__heavyIntervalId = id; }
